issue.title: test_snapshot_includes_live_config_token_refresh_threads flakes under the full parallel lane
issue.description:
Reported by epic phase `sase-sp.6` as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP during the sase-sp landing.
The phase ran a full `just test` on its combined tree (36779 passed, 13 skipped) under
heavy host contention — 27m48s wall clock with many concurrent SASE agent workspaces
live on this machine — and exactly this node failed. An immediate isolated rerun on the
same tree passed.

The subsystem is unrelated to that phase's diff: the phase touched finalizer deferral
adjudication, telemetry, and docs, while this node asserts that the global-state leak
detector's snapshot includes live-config token-refresh threads. That is thread-count
state, which is order- and timing-sensitive under pytest's parallel `-n` lane.

Confirmed still passing in isolation on master at ad9ed74af during the sase-sp landing
turn (1 passed in 2.26s), so the failure is intermittent rather than a standing break.
Serial reproduction has not been attempted; a single full-lane observation is all the
evidence there is.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once in a full just test run (36779 passed, 13 skipped, 27m48s wall clock under heavy multi-agent host contention) during sase-sp.6 verification on 2026-08-24. Passed immediately in isolation on the same tree, and again in isolation on master at ad9ed74af. Fail rate 1/3 observations; not reproduced serially.

payload.description: Global-state leaking between tests is sase-j7's root-cause domain, and this node is that epic's own leak detector; the single observation does not prove the same root cause

evidence.note: Independent reproduction from epic sase-ti landing: phase bead sase-ti.6 recorded this node failing under its full 'just check' lane (which had escalated to the full suite) at HEAD ~9c164528e on 2026-08-25, then passing on immediate direct rerun. Confirmed still green in isolation today on master 1a96ea92b during the sase-ti land turn: tests/test_global_state_leak_detector.py -q -> 19 passed in 5.16s. Same node, same full-parallel-lane-only mechanism as the original sase-sp.6 report; still not reproducible serially.

Observed independently during approved plan 202608/tale_gate_followup_subset_branches.md verification on 2026-08-27. just check escalated to the full suite via core-identity-changed and failed tests/test_global_state_leak_detector.py::test_snapshot_includes_live_config_token_refresh_threads; an immediate isolated rerun on the same tree passed: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_global_state_leak_detector.py::test_snapshot_includes_live_config_token_refresh_threads -q -> 1 passed in 2.33s. The local diff touched gate-shell follow-up parsing/settlement and gate-shell tests, not global-state leak detector code. Turn-local fail/pass observations: 1 full-lane failure, 1 direct isolation pass; serial reproduction not attempted.
